text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Dream Journey—

Dream Journey's gaze is fixed on a crane game
filled with plushies styled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, not me. It seems the juniors on the
Expedition Support Committee are collecting them.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I found the one she's been looking for.
She was searching everywhere because no store had it in stock,
so I thought I'd give it to her as a present.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm not particularly good
at these kinds of games... so I'm not confident I can catch one.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I let this chance slip away...
I might never encounter it ever again, right?
choice_data_list: If you'd like, want me to do it for you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
I would gladly accept.
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
